An '''azurite crystal''' was a rare kind of [[tasar crystal]] that had the ability to turn an individual [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and to imbue them with a specific [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] after several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] of attunement. The azurite crystal was a mottled blue in color, and had the ability to grant an individual the power of [[Remain Conscious]]. [[Valjak]], a [[Tasari]] member of the [[Kiana]], had an azurite crystal inset on his left bracer.<ref name="J15" />
